title.narrative: Community gardens as a GenerACTOR for good governance, active citizenship and participation

description.narrative: GenerACTOR promotes sustainable integrated urban development among local authorities, in full coherence with the objectives of the Call, through innovative local policies aimed at developing new urban agriculture services to: 1) strengthen urban governance; 2) ensure social and economic inclusion of the most vulnerable social groups, 3) improve resilience and greening of cities; 4) Improve prosperity and innovation in cities.
